theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ c : Covector (Eucl P) n, IntegrableOn (fun x => θ x * ξ x c) K ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M)
